info.name: Get participants in a collaboration room

params.name: roomId
params.description: The identifier of the collaboration room.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of participants to return per page.

params.name: startAfter
params.description: Pagination cursor - return participants after this participant id.

items.docs: Returns the participants associated with a collaboration room. List responses use cursor-style pagination via the `limit` and `startAfter` query parameters.
